name: Backend Python and broad database capability
query: Find backend developers with personal Python implementation and broad SQL database implementation experience. Relational schema work, query construction through an ORM, migrations and database performance work can support SQL capability; a database name alone cannot. Handwritten SQL is not required. Where dated employment is supplied, assess at least three years of total employment; this is not three years using each skill.
